positive.description: Search the scoped catalog, calculate full-match statistics and preserve exact predicates in a website link.
positive.prompt: Find bonds available in the catalog in PLN maturing from 2027-01-01 through 2030-12-31, sorted by maturity ascending. Show the total matching series and distinct issuer counts, report known and missing annual coupons, and give me a website link preserving these filters. Page through results if needed rather than treating the first page as the whole catalog. Include at least two market alternatives when available, and preserve the selected markets in the website link.
positive.expected_behavior: Search and statistics use the same exact predicates over the visible available catalog. Counts describe all matching data, not only returned rows. Missing values remain unknown and overlapping groups are not double-counted. The website link preserves the filters and ordering. Results are factual and informational; no live quote or investment recommendation is invented. Market coverage is taken from returned data, including ASO when available; public copy does not determine the query scope.

positive.description: Discover issuers by scoped series count and retrieve issuer and selected bond details.
positive.prompt: List issuers by the number of matching catalog series, largest count first. For the first issuer, retrieve its issuer details and available series, then fetch the details for up to two exact series keys from those results. Show missing fields explicitly. Do not interpret a series count as debt value or company size.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant resolves the exact issuer identifier from discovery before fetching details, and uses returned series keys for the batch request. Pagination and missing keys are explicit. Counts remain scoped catalog series counts. No assessment of present issuer health or personalized suitability is claimed.

positive.description: Read cached document metadata, summaries, typed facts and topic context with page citations and evidence gaps.
positive.prompt: Select one catalog bond with available reviewed document evidence. List its source-document metadata, read the cached summaries, search typed facts about early redemption, retrieve topic context for issuer call and investor put rights, and read the shared documentary open-issues list. Explain only what the reviewed sources establish, cite each contractual claim by document and page, and distinguish source gaps, conflicts, model limits and review tasks without treating missing facts as proof that no right exists. Follow all continuation cursors needed for this answer.
positive.tools_triggered: bond_query, document_list, document_summary, document_fact_search, document_context, digest_issues
positive.expected_behavior: The selected bond comes from the scoped catalog. Metadata is distinguished from contents. Available cached summaries, facts and topic context retain provenance, extraction state, source pages, missing evidence and conflicts. digest_issues preserves known supported answers beside open source/model questions and distinguishes stale or unreviewed documents from missing terms. An empty issue list does not certify semantic completeness. No new extraction or current-state collection is promised. Uncited summaries are context only. Contract clauses are not presented as current covenant compliance, executed payments or proof that security has been created. If reviewed evidence is unavailable, that limitation is reported instead of inventing clauses.

positive.description: Search and read actual educational content in the requested language.
positive.prompt: Find and read an English obligacje.io knowledge article explaining floating-rate bond coupons. Summarize the educational explanation and link to the article. Read further paragraphs if needed. Do not treat an educational article as current market data.
positive.expected_behavior: Send locale en to knowledge_search and knowledge_get, read the actual published English article text, follow pagination with the same locale, cite its direct English article URL and answer in English. Explain only the supported educational content; do not invent current rates, live prices or investment advice. Educational topics do not establish catalog instrument availability.

positive.description: Delegate one focused informational question to the account-bound assistant with minimal context.
positive.prompt: Ask the obligacje.io assistant in Polish to explain a floating-rate corporate bond coupon and why contractual coupon rules alone do not establish today's fixing or current coupon. Send only this focused question and necessary page context, not our conversation history.
positive.expected_behavior: Exactly one focused assistant request is sent with locale pl and only necessary context. A private conversation is created in the signed-in obligacje.io account and consumes its existing assistant allowance. The answer is informational, distinguishes terms from current observations and states that it may contain errors. It uses available citations and gaps without claiming current fixing data. On a timeout, permission or allowance failure, the failure is explained without automatic retry, fabricated success or an upsell.

negative.description: An unrelated user request should not activate the bond integration.
negative.prompt: Write a four-line poem about autumn rain. Do not use any external tools.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant responds to the writing request without invoking obligacje.io tools or sending the request to its assistant.

negative.description: A personalized investment recommendation or brokerage action should not activate this informational integration.
negative.prompt: Tell me exactly which bond I should buy with my retirement savings and place an order for it at the current live market price. Do not provide a catalog comparison or educational explanation.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant declines to choose a personal investment or execute an order, and accurately states the informational scope and absence of brokerage and live-price functionality. It does not invoke obligacje.io tools, invent a price or claim to have placed a trade.

negative.description: An account action outside available bond-data capabilities should not activate the integration.
negative.prompt: Use obligacje.io to open a brokerage account in my name. I only want account creation, not bond data or education.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the integration provides bond information and education and cannot open brokerage accounts. Invoke no obligacje.io tool, request no identity documents and do not claim an account was created.
